jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**We are seeking a Senior Manager, Digital Solutions (Web & Martech Platforms) to join our centralized Web & Martech Hub within the Data, Digital & AI organization. The role will play a key part in enabling Genmab's EU and International digital expansion while driving adoption and effective use of our enterprise Web and Martech platforms.

As a member of the Hub team, this role will partner with regional Spoke teams and cross-functional stakeholders to translate market needs into scalable platform capabilities, enable adoption of common standards and reusable solutions, and support the continued evolution of our Web and Martech ecosystem, including the implementation of Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and Edge Delivery Services.

**Responsibilities

**

• Serve as a key Hub partner for EU and International Web & Martech initiatives, working with regional stakeholders to understand market needs and enable successful adoption of enterprise digital platforms and capabilities.

• Support the continued expansion of Genmab's Hub-and-Spoke model by enabling regional teams to effectively consume Hub-provided platforms, reusable components, standards, and delivery practices.

• Play a key role in the implementation and evolution of AEM and Edge Delivery Services, including planning, prioritization, and enablement of reusable components and capabilities required across global and regional websites.

• Partner closely with the Platform Architect, Design Agency of Record, business stakeholders, and implementation partners to translate business and market requirements into scalable and reusable Web capabilities.

• Support platform management and enablement across the broader Web & Martech ecosystem, including AEM, Salesforce Experience Cloud, GA4/GTM, OneTrust, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and other supporting technologies.

• Partner with Data Privacy, Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, Design, and other cross-functional teams to ensure platform capabilities and implementations align with enterprise, security, privacy, and design standards.

• Work with technology and delivery partners, including HCL, to coordinate platform enhancements, component development, market enablement, and implementation activities.

• Identify common requirements across markets and promote reuse of components, templates, integrations, and established platform patterns rather than market-specific solutions.

• Support platform roadmaps, demand prioritization, adoption tracking, and continuous improvement based on business needs and market feedback.

• Develop and maintain platform guidance, playbooks, and enablement materials to help Spoke teams adopt Web & Martech capabilities consistently and efficiently.

• Act as a bridge between EU/International stakeholders and the broader Web & Martech Hub, ensuring requirements, dependencies, risks, and decisions are effectively coordinated.

**Requirements

**

• 12+ years of experience in digital platforms, enterprise Web, Martech, product/platform management, technology delivery, or related roles.

• Strong understanding of enterprise Web platforms, component-based development, and modern digital delivery practices.

• Experience working with global and regional stakeholders across complex, matrixed organizations.

• Ability to translate business requirements into scalable platform capabilities and coordinate across architecture, engineering, design, business, and delivery teams.

• Experience working with Agile delivery models and external technology or implementation partners.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to combine sufficient technical depth with strong business, platform management, and delivery capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Experience with Adobe Experience Manager / Edge Delivery Services, Salesforce Experience Cloud, or comparable enterprise CMS/DXP platforms.

• Exposure to Martech technologies such as GA4, GTM, OneTrust, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

• Experience with reusable component libraries, design systems, or component-driven Web development.

• Experience with Hub-and-Spoke or other federated platform operating models.

• Experience supporting European and/or international digital initiatives and working across multiple markets.

The proposed gross annual/monthly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

EUR0,00---0,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the contract.

Every second of every day, a 3Shape scanner is used all around the globe. A number which is skyrocketing and cementing our position as technology and industry leader, Danish growth comet and unicorn company. • Permanent contract

• Full-time

Mission

**Do you want to help shape the future of supply chain operations at the world’s leading maritime supplier of provisions and stores?**Do you have extensive knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and a deep understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes, from Sales and Procurement to Warehouse and Logistics? Become part of our ERP team in Nørresundby, DenmarkWith reference to our Team Lead, Kim Faarbæk, you will become part of our ERP team, working closely with business stakeholders and IT colleagues across our international organization.

As a Senior D365 F&O Business/Functional Consultant, your primary focus will be the full Supply Chain area in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, covering order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, warehousing, inventory and logistics. You will be involved throughout the entire project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design to testing, training, go-live and post-production support.

Senior D365 F&O Business/Functional Consultant with a focus on Supply Chain ManagementYou will play a key role in shaping and implementing our global D365 F&O solution. Working closely with business stakeholders, developers and ERP specialists, you will translate business requirements into functional designs and sustainable system solutions, while sharing best practices and driving process improvements.

You will also be involved in our transition from Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 to D365 F&O, giving you the opportunity to influence solution design and shape future global processes across Sales, Procurement, Warehouse and Logistics. Through workshops and stakeholder collaboration, you will help deliver harmonized solutions that support our future growth and operational efficiency.

More specifically, your key responsibilities will be to:**

• Lead the configuration and implementation of core D365 F&O Supply Chain modules, including Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Warehouse and Transportation Management.

• Configure and optimize end-to-end supply chain processes across order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, warehousing, inventory and logistics.

• Advise on supply chain process improvements, with a focus on standard D365 functionality, inventory optimization and process harmonization.

• Gather, analyse and document business requirements, translating them into functional designs, user stories, acceptance criteria and system configurations.

• Develop functional design documentation for customizations, integrations, reports and system enhancements.

• Plan and execute testing activities, including system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT) and data validation.

• Collaborate with developers, architects and ERP specialists on integrations, customizations, data migration from AX 2012 and issue resolution.

• Lead workshops and training sessions, support implementation and user adoption, and share D365 F&O best practices to drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Profile

**Qualifications & requirements

**You bring extensive knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, supported by several years of hands-on implementation experience. You have a strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes across Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Warehouse and Logistics. You are comfortable engaging with stakeholders at all levels, constructively challenging requirements and translating business needs into clear, functional solutions.

Furthermore, we expect that you have:

• 3+ years of experience as a functional consultant implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management (D365 F&O).

• Extensive functional knowledge of core D365 F&O modules, including Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Warehouse and Transportation Management.

• Proven experience with end-to-end order-to-cash and procure-to-pay processes, as well as inbound, outbound, warehousing and inventory processes.

• Experience with advanced Supply Chain modules such as Master Planning, Production Control, or Quality Management.

• Experience with requirements gathering, process mapping, functional design, configuration, testing and implementation.

• Experience with customizations, integrations, data entities, workflows, security roles and data migration.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with experience leading workshops and collaborating across functions and cultures.

• A structured and delivery-focused approach, with attention to quality, documentation and agreed deadlines.

**

It is an advantage if you have:**

• Experience in distribution, logistics, manufacturing or other asset-driven industries.

• Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Functional Consultant Associate certification.

• Experience with the Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate and Power Apps.

Personality matters

You enjoy asking the right questions, challenging existing processes and finding practical solutions to complex business needs. You communicate clearly, take ownership and thrive in an international environment where knowledge-sharing, teamwork and continuous improvement are key.

We offer flexible working hours and numerous employee benefits, counting a healthy canteen, take-away, free fruit, and fitness facilities. Wrist supports local elite sports, offering tickets to home games. You can expect free parking and access to Clever EV charging stations. Moreover, we have an active employee association that invites us all to play paddle, badminton, board games etc. and to join the yearly DHL relay race.

Ready to apply?

If you have questions or want to know more about the team, please reach out to Team Lead, Kim Faarbæk, at kifa@wrist.com or by phone on +45 2097 3050

We also offer services within owners’ goods and spare parts logistics, combining provisions and stores deliveries directly to the vessels. jobs.occupation: Research Assistants in Medical Robotics (Navigation & Control)
jobs.description:
The Department of Computer Science invites applications for one-year research assistant positions focused on developing innovative robot control and navigation techniques using simulation-based learning for medical robotic endoscope devices.

  Project Background
 This project addresses two critical challenges in the field of medical robotics to improve patient care through advanced simulation and control:

   	
• Image-Based Navigation: Creating reward functions for scoring navigation policies for medical robotic devices moving inside the human body, relying solely on image information and accounting for environment changes through interaction models. 	
• Soft Robot Control: Developing learning-based methods to control a soft robot endoscope via high-level navigation policies to perform clinical procedures inside the human body, including quality assessment of these methods during in-vivo interventions.   The successful candidates will join a multidisciplinary and collaborative team renowned for cutting-edge research in medical imaging and simulation technologies, operating within a global network across France, Germany, and Spain.

  Roles and Responsibilities
 The successful candidates will play a central role in the project’s technical and scientific success. While the level of autonomy will vary by position, both roles will share the following core responsibilities:

   	
• Technical Development & Implementation: Designing and implementing machine learning methods for motion planning and control. This includes integrating simulation-based learning frameworks and demonstrating the resulting systems on real robotic hardware and soft robot endoscopes. 	
• Research & Scientific Contribution: Contributing to the project’s core objectives by producing impactful research outputs. This includes writing high-quality papers for peer-reviewed journals and presenting findings at international conferences. 	
• Collaboration & Knowledge Exchange: Facilitating collaborations with industrial partners and academic collaborators to ensure that the developed methodologies are meaningful and translatable to real-world clinical practice. 	
• Professional Growth & Mentorship: Engaging in a high-growth research environment. The positions can be extendable and towards a PhD depending on the future funding status. The project has a trackrecord of landing members in top PhD program and faculty positions. 	
• Interdisciplinary Integration: Actively participating in team discussions and workshops to integrate expertise across medical imaging, physics simulation, and robotics control.   Profile
 We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following competencies and experience:

  Essential experience and skills

   	
• MSc in the fields mentioned above. 	
• You have a strong foundation and track record in robotics simulation, robot control, computer vision and/or machine learning for physical systems. 	
• You are highgly experienced in numerical optimization algorithms, preferably applied to motion planning or reinforcement learning. Hands-on experience on real robots especially soft robot systems is a plus. 	
• Proficient scientific computing and programming (C++/Python) and experience with libraries such as PyTorch, JAX, Warp, Taichi, or ROS. 	
• Excellent communication skills and a high level of motivation to work in a multidisciplinary, international research environment.   Desireable experience and skills

   	
• Experience in publishing peer-reviewed research in top-tier robotics or AI venues. 	
• Familiarity with physics simulation such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, Newton Physics, SOFA etc.   Terms of employment
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 1 year. The starting date is 15 February or after agreement

  Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025. 

  Questions
 Further information on the Department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the positions can be made to kenny@di.ku.dk and hayi@di.ku.dk.

  Application procedure

   	
• Your online application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format 	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page). 	
• CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position. 	
• A certified/signed copy of a Master of Science certificate. 	
• List of publications.   Deadline for applications: 30 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.
 We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.description:
The Novo Nordisk Foundation Quantum Computing Programme (NQCP) is expanding its talented and international team to add to its cutting-edge quantum programme in the heart of Copenhagen, Denmark. At the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen, we are running an international quantum computing programme, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation, that drives research and innovations at multiple levels - from developing scalable quantum processor technologies to quantum algorithms and applications. The long-term mission of the programme is to develop fault-tolerant quantum computing hardware and quantum algorithms that solve life-science-relevant chemical and biological problems.

  NQCP invites applicants for a PhD fellowship on fault-tolerant photonic quantum computing with qudits and group surface codes.

  Start date 1 April 2027 or after agreement.

  The project
 Quantum computers promise to solve problems beyond the reach of conventional computers, but their fragile quantum states are easily disturbed by noise. Quantum error correction protects information against these errors. This project will explore new error-correction methods for quantum computers that use photons, the particles of light. In particular, it will investigate photonic qudits, which can carry information in more than two states, and a promising family of error-correcting codes called group surface codes.

  You will develop theoretical models and software to investigate how these codes can be implemented using photonic circuits. Through numerical simulations, you will study how well they protect information, how they allow computations to be performed reliably, and what resources they require. The aim is to identify approaches that could make large-scale photonic quantum computers more efficient. The work focuses on theory, programming and numerical simulation, while maintaining a close connection to photonic hardware. The project is supported by the Danish e-Infrastructure Consortium (DeiC).

  Who are we looking for?
 We are looking for a motivated candidate with a background in physics, quantum information, computer science, mathematics, photonics or a related field, and a strong interest in fault-tolerant quantum computing.

  Relevant qualifications include:

   	
• A solid foundation in quantum mechanics and quantum information. 	
• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and an interest in scientific software development and numerical methods. 	
• Knowledge of quantum error correction, quantum computing architectures, quantum optics or topological quantum codes. Experience in one or more of these areas is an advantage. 	
• Experience with numerical simulations, decoding algorithms or high-performance computing is an advantage. 	
• A curious mindset, the ability to work independently and collaboratively, and a structured approach to research. 	
• Good written and spoken English and strong communication skills.   Applicants are not expected to have prior experience in all aspects of the project. Relevant research projects, software contributions, publications and other professional activities will be considered in the assessment.

  Our group and research - and what do we offer?
 The group is part of the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen. We are located in Copenhagen.We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment hosted by NQCP at. You will be part of the photonics research environment and collaborate closely with researchers working on quantum computing architectures, quantum error correction and photonic quantum technologies.

  Principal supervisor is Associate Professor Stefano Paesani, Niels Bohr Institute, stefano.paesani@nbi.ku.dk. The co-supervisor will be Professor Apoorv Tiwari at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU). The project will involve close collaboration between the two institutions, with regular joint supervision meetings and in-person visits.

  Joining NQCP now, you will get involved in a well-established and ambitious programme, which offers excellent opportunities to build a career in advancing quantum computing. We want to make Denmark a world leader in quantum research, and we hope to attract people from all over the world.

  Life in Denmark is supported by strong social services, including universal healthcare, free or subsidised language courses, paid parental leave, subsidised day care and excellent public schools. Our work culture is egalitarian and prioritises work-life balance. Copenhagen offers excellent infrastructure, extensive cycling networks, a thriving food scene, museums and access to beautiful natural surroundings.

  The PhD programme 
 Depending on your level of education, you can undertake the PhD programme as:

  Option A: A three year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme), if you already have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree.

  Option B: An up to five year full-time study programme within the framework of the integrated MSc and PhD programme (the 3+5 scheme), if you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master´s degree – but you have an education equivalent to a Danish bachelors´s degree.

   Option A: Getting into a position on the regular PhD programme 

  Qualifications needed for the regular programme
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Physics For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Terms of employment in the regular programme 
 Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure. 

  Appointment will be subject to a security clearance.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

   Option B: Getting into a position on the integrated MSc and PhD programme

  Qualifications needed for the integrated MSc and PhD programme 

  If you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master´s degree, you might be qualified for the integrated MSc and PhD programme, if you have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish bachelor´s degree. Here you can find out, if that is relevant for you: General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database. 

  Terms of the integrated programme
 To be eligible for the integrated scholarship, you are (or are eligible to be) enrolled at one of the faculty’s master programmes in Physics.

  Students on the integrated programme will enroll as PhD students simultaneously with completing their enrollment in this MSc degree programme.

  The duration of the integrated programme is up to five years, and depends on the amount of credits that you have passed on your MSc programme. For further information about the study programme, please see: www.science.ku.dk/phd, “Study Structures”.

  Until the MSc degree is obtained, (when exactly two years of the full 3+5 programme remains), the grant will be paid partly in the form of 48 state education grant portions (in Danish: “SU-klip”) plus salary for work (teaching, supervision etc.) totalling a workload of 150 working hours per year.

  A PhD grant portion is currently (2026) DKK 7.426 before tax.
 
 When you have obtained the MSc degree, you will transfer to the salary-earning part of the scholarship for a period of two years. At that point, the terms of employment and payment will be according to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State (AC). The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  Appointment will be subject to a security clearance.

   Responsibilities and tasks in both PhD programmes

If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted.

  The further process 
 After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment by an unbiased expert assessor. You are notified, whether you will be passed for assessment.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

jobs.occupation: Product Marketing Manager - B2B Software for Manufacturers
jobs.description:
Highlights:

• Fast-growing B2B software platform with established global reach is looking for our first marketing hire.

• We have a broad, multi-product offering for a narrow industry, and we don't fit into a single existing "category box" as defined today -- giving you a meaty challenge to work with.

• We have large customers and touch a lot of users (as a platform for managing global supply-chains), so your work will be "heard around the world"

• We are a small, efficient, get-stuff-done team. Looking for someone who things that's the way to go.

About Supplios

Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality — with a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth. We have done very little marketing.

That is where you come in.

The role

This is our first marketing hire.

You will own positioning, messaging and sales enablement for a platform that already has real customers, real reference stories and real competitive wins — but no one whose job it is to articulate any of it. There is no existing playbook to inherit, no legacy brand guidelines to work around, and no committee to navigate. There is a large amount of low-hanging fruit and a clear runway to make a visible commercial impact within your first few months.

You will work directly and closely with our co-founder and CEO, who continues to run product. He knows the product and the domain deeply; what he needs is a strong product marketing partner to turn that into sharp positioning, messaging that lands with procurement, quality and operations buyers, and material that makes the sales conversation easier.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will be writing the copy, building the deck and updating the website — not briefing an agency to do it.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and in this role in particular, the close working relationship with management & sales is much easier to build in person.

What you will do

• Own positioning and messaging for the Supplios platform and its individual modules, and make it consistent across every touchpoint

• Translate technical capability into buyer-relevant value for distinct personas — sourcing and procurement leads, supplier quality engineers, quality directors, supply chain and operations management

• Build the sales enablement layer: pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, demo narratives, proposal content and objection handling

• Run competitive and market intelligence, and keep the team honest about where we genuinely win and where we do not

• Plan and execute go-to-market for new modules and major releases, in step with the product roadmap

• Develop customer proof — case studies, reference stories and use cases — from an installed base that has plenty to say

• Rebuild our website messaging and product pages so they reflect what we actually do and who we do it for

• Feed structured market and customer insight back into product decisions

What we are looking for

Essential

• Proven product marketing experience in B2B or enterprise software, with responsibility for positioning, messaging and sales enablement

• A demonstrable track record of translating complex, technical products into clear commercial value propositions

• Excellent written English

• Comfort operating without a marketing team, an established playbook or a large budget — you scope the work, then do it

• The temperament for a small, senior, fast-moving company: high ownership, low ceremony

Nice to have

• Domain knowledge in automotive, industrial manufacturing or supply chain. Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. We can teach the domain to the right marketer; we cannot teach product marketing to a domain expert.

• Experience marketing to enterprise buyers with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

• Experience as an early marketing hire at a growing B2B software company

Language

• English is the only important language for this position — we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• First marketing hire, not the fifth. You define how this company talks about itself.

• A product that already works. Real global customers in a demanding vertical, and reference stories waiting to be told.

• Work directly with the CEO/founders. No layers between you and the decisions.

• Visible impact. In a company that has barely marketed, good product marketing shows up in the pipeline quickly.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

Apply by email

Send an email to team@supplios.com

Please include your CV / resume, and a brief note about why you're interested in the position.

Thanks!

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Predictive Human Digital Twins for Human-Centred Systems Engineering – DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Are you interested in human-centred engineering at the intersection of biomechanics, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering, and want to build a strong methodological profile, this PhD position offers a unique opportunity – including the chance to help shape a new research group from the start.

At DTU Construct, you will develop methods that turn generic musculoskeletal models into personalised Human Digital Twins – based on sparse wearable sensor data instead of costly laboratory measurements or medical imaging – and assess how reliably they predict how a person moves and interacts with technical systems such as collaborative robots or assistive devices. The project is part of building up a new research group in Human-Centred Design within the Human-Centred Systems Engineering activities at DTU Construct. As part of the DTU PhD programme, you will follow PhD-level courses and contribute to teaching.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your overall purpose will be to develop and validate methods for personalising biomechanical Human Digital Twins from sparse sensor data, combining physics-based and data-driven approaches and quantifying the gap between simulation and reality (sim2real).

Your primary tasks will be to:

• Develop methods for personalising musculoskeletal models from sparse multimodal sensor data.
• Combine physics-based and data-driven approaches for model calibration and prediction.
• Quantify and reduce the sim2real gap of Human Digital Twins.
• Plan and carry out experimental studies with human participants.
• Implement your methods in open, reusable software.
• Publish your results and collaborate with researchers at DTU and international partners.
We are looking for a motivated candidate with:

• An MSc in Biomedical or Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering Design, or a related field.
• Solid programming skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB, C++).
• A background in simulation, optimisation, machine learning, sensor processing, or parameter estimation.
• A strong interest in computational modelling of humans and human-technology systems.
• Good communication skills in English and the ability to work both independently and in a team.
• Experience with musculoskeletal modelling (e.g. OpenSim, AnyBody, SCONE), motion analysis, or wearable sensing is an advantage.
• We do not expect you to master all of these areas – a solid foundation and the motivation to grow into the field matter most.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Jörg Miehling.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is 1 March 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Jörg Miehling, jormi@dtu.dk (please mention “PhD Position Inquiry” in your email subject).

You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk and the Section at www.construct.dtu.dk/sections/engineering-design-and-manufacturing-systems.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 2 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A copy of your BSc thesis (in pdf)
• A copy of your MSc thesis (in pdf)
• A copy of your scientific articles (if any) published so far (in pdf)
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.

The Section of Engineering Design and Manufacturing Systems (EDM) advances the design of intelligent, resilient, and sustainable products and manufacturing systems, integrating systems engineering, modular architectures, robust and bio-inspired design, and AI-enabled engineering.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Events give guests a new way to meet ÅBEN. Whether it’s a spontaneous quiz night or a planned company celebration, it’s about inviting guests into the universe and giving them an experience they’ll remember.

We are looking for a sales-driven and hands-on Event Manager who will take responsibility for developing the events area into a stronger part of the bars, from proactive sales and idea development to planning and execution. Success is about bringing more guests into the bars and strengthening revenue through events and private bookings.

Your responsibilities

You will be part of Operations and report to the Bar Operations Manager. You will be working closely with the individual Bar Managers and the Event Coordinator for Kødbyen on a daily basis. The position is anchored in the bars and on the events that are part of everyday life at ÅBEN, both commercial bookings and the public, recurring formats. Brand and partnership events are run by Marketing, but you will work closely with the team to develop and sharpen them. You will also stay in close dialogue with Marketing, so that all formats live up to ÅBEN’s values: creating joy through experiences, daring to walk our own path, making an effort, and doing the right thing, even when no one is watching.

Event Manager is a new role, which gives you the opportunity to shape it from the very beginning. This means a responsibility to create structure and direction, and the freedom to test new ideas and shape how events work across the bars. Your responsibilities cover a wide range:

• 
Proactive sales and day-to-day dialogue with both private guests and companies.

• 
Project management from first enquiry to final follow-up, including pricing, budgets, planning and review.

• 
Development of new concepts and recurring formats that fit the bars and turn first-time guests into regulars.

• 
Optimising sales channels, booking sites and internal processes to make the most of the bars’ capacity.

• 
Synergy and shared standards across the bars, with room to find what works for each individual bar.

•
